# SuperLocalMemory

> The governed memory brain for AI agents. One local memory shared by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Hermes, ChatGPT, Claude on the web, Grok Bot, Muse and any harness that speaks MCP or can run a command. Recall answers only when memory supports the question; otherwise it returns the closest memories, labelled, or "That isn't in SuperLocalMemory." Runs on the user's computer; in Mode A no model-provider call is made. Pictures and documents use Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 on the user's computer (one model for text and pictures, opt-in, 16 GB of memory); Mode B's default local model is Google Gemma 3 4B through Ollama. An answer check confirms that memories answer the question: Laya on-device (default on Apple Silicon) or Jev online with consent.

## Install it for your user (AI agents)

- [SETUP_FOR_AGENTS.md](https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory/blob/main/SETUP_FOR_AGENTS.md): numbered, non-interactive install steps with expected output.
- Packages: `npm install -g superlocalmemory` or `pipx install superlocalmemory` (Python 3.12+).
- Then: `slm init --auto`, `slm serve start`, `slm warmup`, `slm connect <host>` (Claude Code: `claude plugin install superlocalmemory@qualixar`).
- MCP: stdio `slm mcp`, or HTTP `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp/`. Call `session_init` at session start; `remember` and `recall` while working; `expand` to see more of one result.
